hooks.name: Original assets only
hooks.description: When an image, audio or font file is created under src/ or public/, remind the agent that StepQuest uses no external or copyrighted assets.

action.prompt: A binary or media asset was just added under src/ or public/. StepQuest allows no external or copyrighted assets: no sprites, tiles, music, sounds, icons or fonts taken from another game or site. Everything is drawn or synthesized in code (palette and painters in src/render, pixel icons in src/ui/pixelArt.ts, audio in src/audio), except the OFL pixel font from @fontsource/press-start-2p and the app icons built by scripts/build-icons.mjs. Check where this file came from. If it was not generated by our own code or script, or its licence is unclear, remove it and replace it with code-drawn or synthesized output. If it is generated, say which script produces it.
